title: EDGAR ingestion: fetch S-1 HTML/PDF + parse node tree (sections, anchors, tables)
description: Implement repeatable ingestion from SEC EDGAR (given CIK/accession). Parse primary HTML into a hierarchical node tree, extract tables with a real HTML parser, persist anchors for citations, and store raw artifacts for caching/debug.

title: Fix chunk explosion bug in semantic splitting
description: splitTextAtSemanticBoundaries() continued emitting near-duplicate tail chunks when endPos==text.length, causing tens of thousands of chunks for a single filing. Add a termination condition when we consume to end.
close_reason: Fixed in code: stop emitting tail overlap chunks in splitTextAtSemanticBoundaries().

title: Table parsing v2: handle rowspan/colspan + header detection
description: S1Processor still parses element.table_body via regex (src/processor/S1Processor.ts). Replace with cheerio-based HTML table matrix extraction that supports rowspan/colspan, header row detection, and produces a stable markdown/text_view for retrieval + exact citations via anchor/source_url.

title: S-1 chunking v2: typed chunks + parent/child context + citation anchors
description: Replace fixed char chunking with S-1-aware chunking: paragraph chunks, risk-factor chunks, MD&A chunks, and table row-group chunks. Preserve hierarchy (section_path) and stable anchors (HTML id / page label) for citations. Add parent/child retrieval support.
notes: Progress: fixed semantic splitter tail duplication (mastra-stanley-1ud) and added section-aware chunk_type + avoid mixing anchors inside a chunk (commit f1a6946). Next: risk-factor/MD&A substructure + parent/child context + token budgeting.

title: Deep scrub + S-1 ingestion/retrieval spec
description: Deeply review current repo (ingestion -> chunking -> embeddings -> retrieval -> Mastra agents/workflows) and write an S-1-specific spec + implementation plan to make it reliable, high-quality (no slop), and 10x more performant. Include chunking strategy, table handling, citations, eval harness, and Mastra best practices.
notes: Drafted spec + plans: docs/S1_AGENT_SPEC.md, docs/RETRIEVAL_ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/EVALUATION.md.

title: Upgrade Mastra + dependency hygiene (pin versions, adopt new APIs, remove 'latest')
description: Upgrade to current Mastra release. Pin dependency versions (remove 'latest'), update APIs (e.g., requestContext vs runtimeContext if applicable), and replace bespoke vector query tools with Mastra RAG primitives where it helps. Ensure scripts still run.

title: Evaluation harness: add eval/queries.jsonl + retrieval/answer benchmarks + CI gates
description: Implement the evaluation plan in docs/EVALUATION.md: create query suite JSONL, add npm scripts for eval:retrieval and eval:answers, collect latency/cost metrics, and add CI-friendly gates to prevent slop regressions.

title: Hybrid retrieval v2: Postgres FTS + pgvector ranking + section/type priors
description: Move keyword scoring from in-memory BM25 to Postgres full-text search (tsvector) and combine with pgvector similarity. Implement a single hybrid retrieval tool that supports filing_id filters, section/type priors, and query-time knobs (HNSW ef / IVF probes).

title: De-Figma: make pipeline filing-agnostic (filing_id, config, no hard-coded counts/values)
description: Remove Figma-specific assumptions across prompts, IDs, heuristics, and scripts. Introduce filing_id everywhere (chunks, embeddings, tools). Replace hard-coded chunk/table counts with computed values.

title: Facts layer: extract and store structured S-1 facts (financials, offering terms, ownership)
description: Add a fact schema/store and implement extractors for: (1) financial statement line items (revenue, gross profit, opex, net loss, cash), (2) offering terms (price range, primary vs secondary shares, greenshoe, proceeds), (3) beneficial ownership (5% holders, voting power, dual-class). Every fact must have evidence (chunk/table anchor + quote).

title: Fix test script (jest missing)
description: package.json defines "test": "jest" but jest is not installed. Decide: add a lightweight test runner (node:test or vitest/jest) OR remove/replace the script; add at least one smoke test for chunking + table parsing.
